title: Cardinality of the fixed algebraic closure of the p-adic numbers
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime and let $\mathbf Q_\ell$ be the field of $\ell$-adic numbers [def-weil-l-adic-numbers]. Let $\Omega_\ell=\operatorname{AlgebraicClosure}(\mathbf Q_\ell)$ be the chosen Mathlib algebraic closure [def-weil-algebraic-closure], also denoted $\operatorname{PadicAlgCl}(\ell)$. Then $|\Omega_\ell|=2^{\aleph_0}$, where $|S|$ denotes the cardinality of a set $S$ and $\aleph_0=|\mathbf N|$.
